about: When each sentence of the voice-over starts (seconds), shared by barista.html, sound.js and voice.js. beats: the 8 lines of the script; voice: where voice.js puts each piece of the ElevenLabs take (Roger, 25 Oct), null for the pieces left out (the take also reads the time stamps aloud); marks: the scan and the two taps, on the words they go with.
